description: One row per redemption of a posRewardCatalogItems reward by a client. Always paired, in the same transaction, with a REDEEM row in posRewardTransactions and a decrement of posRewardBalances. This is the write side of spending POS loyalty points — it never touches the loan-rewards or arcade-chip systems.

fields.name: pointsSpent
fields.description: Denormalized copy of posRewardCatalogItems.requiredPoints at the moment of redemption — later catalog edits must not change past redemption history.

fields.name: incomeId
fields.description: Ticket the redemption's discount was applied to, when relevant. NULL for a standalone free-product redemption not tied to a specific ticket.

fields.name: redeemedByUserId
fields.description: POS user/cashier who processed the redemption.

relationships.notes: Multi-tenant isolation via companyId — injected automatically by stored procedures.
catalogItemId references the reward that was redeemed.

components.name: PosRewardRedemptionListStep
components.description: IonList of past redemptions newest-first: client, reward name, pointsSpent, status badge, created_At.

components.name: PosRewardRedeemModal
components.description: Cashier-facing modal: pick an active catalog reward the selected client can afford (requiredPoints <= current balance), confirm, redeem.

endpoints.description: Takes { companyId, clientId, catalogItemId, redeemedByUserId, incomeId? }. In one transaction: (1) reads the client's current balance from posRewardBalances and the reward's requiredPoints from posRewardCatalogItems, (2) if balance < requiredPoints, rolls back and returns { error: 'insufficient_points', balance } — never a partial redemption, (3) otherwise inserts this row (status='applied', pointsSpent=requiredPoints), (4) inserts a matching REDEEM row in posRewardTransactions (referenceType='redemption', referenceId=this row's id), (5) decrements posRewardBalances.balance and increments lifetimeRedeemed. Returns { status:'applied', redemptionId, pointsSpent, newBalance } on success.

hints: sp_posRewardRedemptions_redeem must be transactional as described in the endpoint above — insufficient balance rolls back everything, never a partial write.
Index (clientId, created_At DESC) for a client's redemption history.
